m08 the inner instrument (layout line — operations in series): buddhi steps to its office ('determines') while ahaṃkāra and manas hold as standing operations; pointer repel 0.4 — the subject is not among the instruments.
m09 vikalpa → saṃkalpa: the walker contracts from wide-faint to tight-dark (many alternatives gather into one intention); vortex pointer + implode click; circulation LFO = the gathering swirl.

m10 apoha: the centre steps 'a promise' → 'not prediction' → 'not idle remark' while the excluded alternatives (prediction/hope/idle) dim by degrees — determination by graduated exclusion, the record's own example; shove pointer = the exclusions' edge.

m11 3D (z = the descent of manifestation): the walker descends #0 → #2 → #5→0 through the depth axis while #1/#3/#4 hold their stations — the sixfold as an inhabitable depth; any local unit retains the whole descent (the record's hologram image). Depth LFO = the descent breathes.

m12 the means: 'the means' → 'internal' → 'objective' — the record's two-sided definition delivered in sequence, inside a faint horizon ring (the lived horizon partly transparent to its conditions); transitions lengthen to 1.8 — the station releases slowly into §1.

Legibility pattern (all members, 2026-10-06; bounds corrected 2026-10-06 after the wave-2 audit): (a) on 40 scenes a sequence whose carrier is a non-text formation walks on a dedicated TEXT-shaped walker entity — the original formation stays as the quiet field form behind it (tintWeight ≤ 0.25) and those scenes hold calm field physics (speed ≤ 0.6, circulation ≤ 0.5, turbulence ≤ 0.22; speed LFOs clamped ≤ 0.7) so the walking letterform can condense — the wave-1 legible-walk pattern; (b) on 16 scenes the sequence carrier is already a text-shaped formation and keeps its own authored physics (measured maxima: speed 0.8, circulation 1.7, turbulence 0.34), which the render pass pixel-verified holds the letterforms. Craft rework 2026-10-07 (expression rework pass, lane 4; records re-read at fc59a719). The shared chassis and word-walkers are retired; each movement draws its own figure. m07 night: sheer light bends back and closes into the loop — prakāśa and vimarśa one dynamism, drawn twice beside it. m08 the same night held (deliberate rest): the inner instrument boxed B/A/M, reflection dashes above, the pole ○ beneath the frame. m09 dusk and vortex: the fan of vikalpa, saṃkalpa's single gathered course, the pulse returning as inherited field; circulation LFO = the pulse. m10 day arrives with determination: the field of what-is-not, the boxed 1, the dashed contrast carried (the softmax payoff stays withheld for §5, as the record withholds it). m11 the same day held (deliberate rest): six shelves descend, māyā's seam splits the lower run, recognition's arrow returns; beside it the six discs shrink to the gold return. m12 cold morning: poles and bare field, determinate relations drawn in, reflection reaching back through the means; the three offices ring-square-triangle. Stillness pairs: m07–m08 (one night, awareness and its instrument), m10–m11 (one day, determination and its anatomy). Colour arc: night → dusk → day → cold morning — the world determinating. glyph_rationales.the reflexive bend: M07: the first differentiation — the bend by which luminous awareness takes its own manifestation as other enough to encounter (prakāśa-vimarśa as one non-dual dynamism)
glyph_rationales.the one dynamism: M07: prakāśa and vimarśa are one non-dual dynamism — their distinction arises within the activity, drawn as one ring holding both
glyph_rationales.prakāśa — the light: M07: luminosity — sheer appearing, the straight beam before it bends
glyph_rationales.vimarśa — the reflection: M07: self-recognition — the beam returned to its source, same dynamism faced back
glyph_rationales.the inner instrument: M08: buddhi (judgment), ahaṃkāra (appropriation), manas (coordination) — determinate internal functions, reflectable as contents
glyph_rationales.the pole: M08: the subject as the pole under which the functions and their products appear — never one more function
glyph_rationales.the differentiating pulse: M09: vikalpa and saṃkalpa as one pulse on √kḷp — the field differs, a course gathers, the act changes what the next act inherits
glyph_rationales.the inherited field: M09: memory, language, concern and means — the circumstance active before every condition is separately named, giving alternatives their character
glyph_rationales.determination through exclusion: M10: apoha — a selected 1 intelligible against the field of what it is not; the double negation non-collapsing, the contrast semantically carried
glyph_rationales.the selected one: M10: the achieved term — determinate, boxed, never self-sufficient
glyph_rationales.the excluded field: M10: the constitutive contrast — exclusion that remains operative in the meaning of the term
glyph_rationales.the sixfold descent: M11: thirty-six tattvas carried as six movements — the drawn shelves descend, māyā's seam splits the lower run, recognition's arrow returns
glyph_rationales.the tattvic descent: M11: thirty-six tattvas carried as six movements — the discs shrink down the descent to recognition, gold because it returns the run to its ground
glyph_rationales.the mediating means: M12: objective internality — internal (situated mediating field) and objective (determinate relations available to reflection, comparison, correction)
glyph_rationales.subjective immediacy: M12: the first office — the non-objectifiable pole of the living relation
glyph_rationales.objective internality: M12: the middle office — the constituted means, distinct from the Subject and from the World
glyph_rationales.world: M12: the third office — the world the means discloses and acts within; three offices, one relation (Life / Mind)
